title: RCM is one module of an EHR platform

company.name: Carestack Systems
company.segment: EHR with integrated revenue cycle module

input.facts: Core product is an ambulatory EHR; a revenue cycle module is sold as an add-on to 40% of customers. Recurring revenue is 76% of sales. The share price fell 34% after a one-off charge on a platform migration. No holder above 25%. No regulatory issue.

why: RCM bundled with EHR is acceptable under the thesis; the other criteria are met: Priority.
